title: calathiana tergestina
intro: Calathiana tergestina, commonly known as the Alpine Marigold, is a flowering plant species native to the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Calathiana tergestina are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
